name: Lagoon
description: Thick rings breached on one side, the gap swinging round the rim from cell to cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { width: 82%; height: 82%; margin: 9%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 56%, #000 56%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 56%, #000 56%); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 42%, 56% 42%, 56% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 42%, 56% 42%, 56% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
